projects.title: Summerville 115kV Loop: Rebuild
projects.summary: Replacing several wood pole sections on the Summerville 115 kV Loop that have reached the end of life.

places.label: Summerville
places.coordinateSource: OSM way/185236364 power=substation substation=transmission voltage=230000;115000 (unnamed). HIFLD 113527 (SCE&G 230 kV, 22.9 km) runs from OSM way/184867924 'Williams Substation' to this sub.
places.validation: This is DESC's 'Summerville 230kV Sub' (SCRTP 2024-28 05004 P) and the Summerville end of the 'Williams - Summerville 230 kV' line (SCRTP 6388 A). It is the only 230/115 kV transmission sub in Summerville, and HIFLD's 230 kV line from Williams ends here; I re-checked that geometry myself. Nominatim reverse puts it in Berkeley County, in the Summerwood part of Summerville. HIFLD shows 115 kV lines leaving it west and south into Dorchester County. The gazetteer's 'Summerville Substation' at 34.47,-85.34 is in Summerville, Georgia, a same-name false match that was correctly rejected. OSM has no name tag, so the ID rests on topology.

constructionWindows.note: Coarse budget-year window: first budgeted spending year → planned in-service date. DESC publishes yearly spending, not construction dates; spending also occurred before 2026.

caveats: The point is the loop's source substation, not the work site. Dominion's page (desc-summerville-loop-page) describes about 8 miles of 115 kV wood-to-steel replacement in Dorchester County, starting fall 2025 and running to summer 2026. HIFLD shows the Summerville 115 kV lines running up to about 8 km west and southwest of this point (for example HIFLD 141505 to 32.984,-80.212).
The source gives an impossible date (04/31/26); shown at month precision.
